behavior: Every r2_backup_node line carries newest_snapshot, snapshot_age_seconds (null on restic failure) and reachable
The freshness rule fires for a reachable on-demand node with a snapshot older than 3h on two probes, and stays silent for off, always-on, fresh and all-off cases
The shrink rule fires on a >50% drop between consecutive probes and not on growth, a single probe or a null size
targets.txt carries each node's Tailscale IP, probe port and class from common.yaml and make validate-sync catches drift
A live prod watcher run reports the new fields for every node, with reachable=1 on vps, rpi3 and an up on-demand node
reachable=0 on an always-on node makes the health verdict unhealthy
verification: poetry run pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_r2_backup_watcher_probe.py -k always_on
